turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good morning, this is Adam calling from Swift Parcel Delivery. We tried to drop off a parcel for you yesterday, but nobody was home.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh right. I wasn't expecting anything, but it could be a birthday present.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That'll be it. It's being held at our depot. There's just a small redelivery fee of one pound forty-five so that our driver can bring it tomorrow.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, that's not much. Can I pay when it arrives?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'm afraid it has to be paid now, or the parcel goes back to the sender at midnight tonight. I can take your card details over the phone.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hang on, let me grab a pen.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Of course. So I just need the long number on the card, the expiry date and the three digits on the back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Is it safe to give that over the phone?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It's completely secure, this line is encrypted. You'll also get a text message with a six digit code in a moment. I'll need you to read that to me as well, to confirm the payment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Why would you need a code for one pound forty-five?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It's only our security check, it takes two seconds. The driver's schedule closes in a few minutes, so we do need to do this right now.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hold on, let me find my glasses.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No problem, I'll wait, but please be quick. Have you got the card in front of you?
